message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charges based on facts. The defendant purchased a nail gun (射钉枪) and modified it with parts to make a non-standard firearm that uses gunpowder to fire non-standard ammunition. This is illegal firearm manufacturing/modification. In Chinese criminal law, offenses include illegal possession of firearms, illegal manufacturing of firearms, illegal possession of ammunition, etc. The relevant statutes: 《刑法》第二百七十五条 违反枪支管理规定罪 (非法制造、买卖、运输、携带、持有枪支、弹药、零部件等). Also possibly “非法制造枪支、弹药罪”. The facts: He purchased a nail gun, then modified it into a non-standard gun. That is illegal manufacturing of a firearm. Also illegal possession of firearm components. So charge: 非法制造枪支罪? Actually the law: 第275条 违反枪支管理规定罪 includes manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, carrying, possessing firearms, ammunition, parts without permission. So the charge is 违反枪支管理规定罪. The instruction: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "违反枪支管理规定". If multiple, separate with semicolons. Here only one.
